# The NNTP error alert checks the running URI before inspecting its window

Mapped alerts and error-page redirection require errorName, runningUri and uri. The code starts silent, then enables a visible alert only for a truthy msgWindow. Its existing exception condition can still rethrow. The owned phase clears status and quits afterward; accepted source contains later asynchronous close coordination, so that immediate quit sequence is historical.

Scope: NNTP mapped-error alert scope.
